name: Agent Failure Autopsy

intake_boundary.purchase_covers: one failed execution of one agent workflow
intake_boundary.over_boundary: Use the included clarification round to select the relevant slice. The clock does not start until the accepted corpus is usable and inside every boundary.
intake_boundary.cannot_fit: If the legitimate one-run case cannot be brought inside every boundary, refund USD 29.
intake_boundary.obfuscated_or_injected_evidence: QUARANTINE_AS_UNUSABLE; use the single slice opportunity; refund if it remains unusable, regardless of alleged intent

buyer_supplies: the coding harness and relevant stack name
one or more redacted transcript, log, or screenshot artifacts

clock.starts: when the last artifact needed to make the submitted evidence usable arrives
clock.business_day_rule: same local wall-clock time on the next Monday through Friday; any holiday adjustment must be stated before the clock starts

delivery: an evidence-linked timeline and failure chain with the first meaningful divergence marked
primary and contributing causes with calibrated confidence
an adversarial challenge of each causal explanation against plausible alternatives
concrete prompt, configuration, or code fix steps only where the supplied evidence supports them
refund: Refund USD 29 when the accepted artifacts cannot support a defensible diagnosis after the included clarification, when a legitimate one-run case cannot fit the intake boundary, when quarantined evidence remains unusable after the slice opportunity, or when a seemingly usable case does not survive adversarial review. Never rush an unsupported diagnosis to meet the clock.

operator_time_measurement.measurement_rule: Record actual automated-draft and independent-reviewer minutes for each buyer delivery. Never use elapsed time to truncate the analysis or reduce evidence fidelity.

privacy: Buyer evidence and buyer reports remain in an owner-private delivery system unless the buyer explicitly authorizes a public excerpt. The checked-in example is synthetic.
